heard: a three-ton stone lion flew over Beijing city walls. In 1626, the imperial Wang Gongchang gunpowder armory suddenly exploded. The blast instantly flattened two square kilometers of the capital. A mushroom cloud rose and about 20,000 people perished. Strangely, the violent shockwave stripped many victims of their clothes. The emperor survived but the blast killed his infant heir. No one explained what launched that massive stone guardian.
